title: Detailed magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Wand shaft -->
  <rect x="45" y="30" width="10" height="60" rx="3" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Shaft highlight -->
  <rect x="47" y="30" width="3" height="60" rx="1.5" fill="#A87850"/>
  <!-- Shaft band 1 -->
  <rect x="43" y="45" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <rect x="43" y="45" width="14" height="2" rx="1" fill="#F0D060"/>
  <!-- Shaft band 2 -->
  <rect x="43" y="62" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <rect x="43" y="62" width="14" height="2" rx="1" fill="#F0D060"/>
  <!-- Shaft band 3 -->
  <rect x="43" y="78" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <rect x="43" y="78" width="14" height="2" rx="1" fill="#F0D060"/>
  <!-- Star base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="25" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <!-- Star - 5 pointed -->
  <polygon points="50,5 53.5,17 66,17 56,24 59.5,36 50,29 40.5,36 44,24 34,17 46.5,17" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- Star inner glow -->
  <polygon points="50,9 52.5,18 62,18 54.5,23.5 57,32 50,27.5 43,32 45.5,23.5 38,18 47.5,18" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <!-- Star center spark -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="20" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Sparkles around star -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <!-- Small sparkle crosses -->
  <path d="M15,18 l1.5,1.5 -1.5,1.5 -1.5,-1.5z" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <path d="M85,18 l1.5,1.5 -1.5,1.5 -1.5,-1.5z" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- Wand tip glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="4" fill="#FFE44D" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
